title: We Are Aliens Film Wins Award at Hawai'i Int'l Film Festival
content: Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film won the Kau Ka Hōkū (Shooting Star) Award at the 46th Hawai'i International Film Festival in Waikiki on Sunday. The award honors an international filmmaker's first or second feature.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms How Many Seasons It Will Be Before It Ends
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially wrapped up its debut season with Paramount+, and the minds behind it all revealed how many seasons the show will be before it comes to an end.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Teases Big Movie Reveals With Jump Festa 2027 Update
content: One Piece has quite a lot in the works for a release next year, and the franchise has revealed there will be some big teases for those new projects later this year as part of Jump Festa 2027.
author: ComicBook

title: New 'Nippon Anime Awards' Event Announced for November 2027
content: The Tokyo Anime Next event at Tokyo Tatemono Brillia Hall announced on Monday the new "Nippon Anime Awards" event, which will take place at SGC Hall Ariake on November 21, 2027.
author: ANN

title: New Disney Villains Anime Confirms Season 2 Disney+ Release Date With First Look
content: A major anime giving the classic Disney Villains roster a surprise makeover has now set the release date for its return to Disney+ with the first look and details for its next big season.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at Noelle’s Most Powerful Form
content: Black Clover Season 2 is gearing up for the fight against the next member of the Dark Triad, and the first look at the anime’s next episode is showing off Noelle Silva’s most powerful form.

title: Voice Actor Ryūji Nakagi Dies at 89
content: There was a private funeral for close relatives. Nakagi was born on October 24, 1936 in Tokyo. Nakagi's roles included Gōzō Yūtenji in Yawara! title: Comic CMOA Partially Resumes Service
content: NTT Solmare announced on Thursday that its Comic CMOA manga service has partially resumed service, after it suspended service for maintenance for almost two weeks due to an unauthorized external access.
author: ANN

title: AI no Idenshi's Kyūri Yamada Launches New Manga
content: Kodansha 's Comic Days platform announced on Sunday Kyūri Yamada will launch a new manga titled Nanabun no Survivor ( The One-Seventh Survivor ) on Monday. The series will also serialize on Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform beginning November 16.
author: ANN

title: Toshimichi Uzō Launches New Manga
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE platform announced on Friday writer Toshimichi Uzō will launch a new manga with artist Yuitsu titled Yome wo Dungeon de Koroshitai (I Want to Kill My Bride in a Dungeon) on the platform on Tuesday.
author: ANN
